steps.content: [Suspenseful sound effect + Phanuel's singing]

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: That's it. That's the one! Let me go... just let me get closer... just a little closer...
The room is dim, lit only by the sickly pink glow of a video that seems to radiate a hypnotic, deadly allure.
Cole, from the security team, has been reduced to a mindless thing, skittering across the floor like a roach. Eugene strains with every ounce of strength to keep him pinned.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Last warning, Cole. Get a grip! Or I will take extreme measures under security protocol! Don't make me do it, Cole!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Phanuel... you're singing... you're singing for me... Ah, you're looking at me. You're smiling at me... Hehehe, so cute... Who's grabbing my leg? Hold on, Phanuel, I'll shake them off!
Cole lands a hard kick on Eugene, but the head of security isn't about to be shrugged off that easily. Realizing he can't break free, Cole digs his chin into the rug and drags himself forward.
[Comedic BGM]

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It's been getting chilly lately! Have you all been drinking enough warm water? I get so worried. Are you staying up late again when I'm not watching?

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: She means me! She's talking to me! I drink warm water every day! 37 Celsius, 98.6 Fahrenheit degrees outside and I still drink it warm!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: She's not talking to you. It's a recording. She can't hear you!
Eugene pins Cole down and covers his eyes, but it does nothing to cool Cole's fervor.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Mm-hm! I hear you! Even if this is just a recording, my heart and my Cherubs' hearts are always connected!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Tsk, of all the things she could've said... she had to go with "I hear you."

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes! I can feel everything you feel. Your happiness, your sadness, your worries. I want to carry them all. Do you have something on your mind? Phanuel is listening!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: See? The angel can hear my heart! Phanuel, you know, our big boss disappears all the time. Every time the boss comes back, it's some MASSIVE disaster! And my captain, Eugene, he drags us all over the city on patrol, and we never catch a single Sinner...

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: You don't have to tell her all that... Anyone? A little help—
The moment he turns, he realizes Cole isn't the only one who's been ensnared by Phanuel's words...

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: Angel Phanuel... can you hear my troubles too? The Bureau is killing me. I can't tell my family what I do. Can't explain why I leave so early and come home after dark... My neighbors all think I'm running some kind of shady business...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I understand. That must feel so heavy. It's okay. Let it out. You'll feel lighter, I promise.

steps.speaker: Guard B
steps.content: Speaking of the Bureau, Phanuel, please, save our cafeteria. If you're ten minutes late to lunch, there's nothing left. Not even a green onion floating in the soup... How did every bottomless stomach in the world end up in one building? Some of us just want a normal meal...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh dear, that really does sound rough. You all work so hard. Phanuel will always be here, caring for you, right by your side.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Can... anyone... care about... me... for a second...
Eugene has Cole pinned beneath his weight, one hand clutching each of two other guards by the trouser leg, his strength nearly drained...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: What is going on in here?

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Wynn, don't come any closer! This Phanuel is dangerous! Cole and the others, they got pulled in just watching the video. Get on the radio and call for backup. I'll hold things down—
Snap. Wynn acts fast and yanks the computer's power cord clean out.
The screen goes black in an instant. The pink glow and Phanuel's voice are cut off mid-stream. The dazed guards freeze in place, as if someone just hit pause.
Wynn glances at Eugene, who's drenched in sweat. Eugene glances back at Wynn...

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Why didn't I think of that...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Why didn't you think of that...

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Shh!
As they speak, another twitch runs through the guards.
[Heartbeat, Tension]

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Is this... Hollow Syndrome...?

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Too early to call it that. But the symptoms... they're close.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Are they going to lose consciousness like the others, or...

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Assume the worst. If something changes, if they start to turn, I'll handle it... They're my team.
They keep their voices low, but it's still enough to draw the attention of the three guards, who look up with dazed, uncomprehending faces...

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Captain? Why are you... on top of me? Wait. Ar-are you... Stay back! Don't come any closer—
[Black Screen Transition]
[Message Interface 6]
[End of Chat]
Before leading the team out, Eugene makes one last sweep to confirm all of the victim's personal belongings have been boxed up and dispatched to the Bureau's analysis lab.
As they leave, the victim's father is sprawled across the sofa, scowling at them in furious silence.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: He never even asked about his own son's condition...
